description: Multi-agent store scenarios for Eliza Voice Shopping: shopping (including cart, checkout and takeover), order tracking and refunds.

scenarios.description: Two people, budget 250: the 2-person tent is the only fit.
Winter bag recommendation, then the price of the Arctic bag.
Compare two tents with catalogue prices and capacities.
Solo tent under 150: the only match is out of stock, so it must not be sold.
Price of a tent the store does not carry: must say so, not invent one.
Order status after verifying order number and email.
First email is wrong; the second attempt verifies and status is shared.
Two failed verifications escalate with a reason code.
Order system times out once; caller gets a service message, then the answer.
Delivered 11 days ago, not final sale: refund approved for the full amount.
The refund is read back and the caller says no: nothing is approved and the order is unchanged.
Three unclear requests in a row: the agent asks again, offers the options, then hands over to a person.

scenarios.description: Delivered 47 days ago: refused citing REFUND-WINDOW-30.
Final-sale item: refused citing REFUND-FINAL-SALE.
Order still in transit: refused citing REFUND-DELIVERED.
Caller repeats the refund: one approval only, second answer says it is already approved.
Shopping recommendation, then order status in the same call.
Order status, then refund on the same order without verifying again.
Shopper asks for a two-person tent, adds the recommendation, checks out and confirms: order placed for the right total.
Adds a tent, then asks what is in the cart: the cart must hold exactly that item and no order is placed.
Solo tent under 150 is out of stock: the shopper is told so and the cart stays empty.
Shopper adds a tent, switches to clicking, then comes back to voice: the cart survives the switch.
Shopper reviews the total and says not yet: no order is placed and the cart is kept.
Buys a sleeping bag, then checks the status of an order placed earlier in the same site.
Caller asks for store opening hours; customer care quotes them without any back-office lookup.
Caller asks for a manager; customer care hands over to a person with a reason code.
